title: GTM Systems Engineer
description:
Back to careers

GTM Systems

GTM Systems Engineer

Build Jarvislabs' AI-native go-to-market system. Use code, data, automation, AI tools, and customer understanding to create leverage without becoming a spam engine.

Apply via build@jarvislabs.ai

Jarvislabs needs an AI-native go-to-market system, not a traditional sales motion copied from old playbooks. Today we do not have enough CRM discipline, customer intelligence, product usage analysis, proactive sales, or automated SDR workflows. We want someone who can build that machine.

This role is for a hands-on founder/operator type who can use code, AI tools, data, automation, and customer empathy to create a high-quality GTM system. Talking manually does not scale, but the system must be grounded in real customer understanding. The job is to build leverage without becoming a spam engine.

**What You Will Own**

* Build the CRM and customer intelligence foundation for Jarvislabs.
* Connect data from existing Jarvislabs users, website behavior, product usage, public internet sources, company lists, and relevant E2E context.
* Build systems for lead discovery, enrichment, segmentation, prioritization, and similar-customer discovery.
* Create AI-assisted workflows for account research, personalization, outreach generation, follow-up, campaign tracking, and reporting.
* Build dashboards and alerts that show which customer segments, campaigns, signals, and messages are working.
* Design automated SDR workflows that are high quality, technically credible, and respectful of customers.
* Run experiments across outbound, product-led growth, website conversion, technical campaigns, and customer reactivation.
* Manually inspect early customer conversations and outcomes so automation is calibrated to reality.
* Work closely with FDEs and platform engineers to turn customer patterns into better messaging, better products, and better targeting.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A hands-on builder who can write code with AI tools like Claude Code or Codex and still own correctness.
* Enough JavaScript, Python, API, database, scraping, automation, and integration ability to build real internal systems.
* Strong customer empathy and business judgment.
* High agency and founder-like ownership: you figure out what needs to be done without waiting for a playbook.
* Comfort with messy data, public internet research, product analytics, CRM workflows, email systems, and experimentation.
* Strong taste: you know the difference between personalized, useful outreach and low-quality spam.

**Strong Pluses**

* Founder or early startup operator experience, especially in B2B, devtools, AI, cloud, product, or SaaS.
* Experience building GTM automations, enrichment systems, outbound systems, growth experiments, or revenue dashboards.
* Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Customer.io, Segment, PostHog, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or similar tools.
* Ability to ship internal tools, scripts, data pipelines, and lightweight apps quickly.
* Understanding of AI product customers, developers, ML teams, or GPU/cloud buyers.

**This Role Is Not For You If**

* You want a traditional SDR, AE, marketer, or RevOps-only role.
* You only want to configure SaaS tools and avoid building systems.
* You want automation without customer understanding.
* You optimize for volume over quality.
* You cannot review, debug, and own code produced with AI tools.

**How to apply**

Send a personal note to build@jarvislabs.ai. Tell us why Jarvis Labs, what you can contribute, and share proof of serious work. CV-only applications are not reviewed.

Write to us

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Technology->Mobile Development->React Native
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. Develop reusable and modular UI components following best coding practices. Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services. Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and user experience. Implement state management solutions such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, or Context API. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and QA teams. Write clean, maintainable, and testable code. Conduct code reviews and participate in technical discussions. Debug and resolve application issues across Android and iOS platforms. Ensure application security, quality, and scalability. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint activities.

title: Systems Engineer- II
description:
**Responsibilities (List All)**
* Lead projects to achieve cost, quality and schedule targets.
* Build system\-level prototypes and plan engineering builds to evaluate and validate product designs.
* Coordinate cross\-functional feedback from engineering builds and drive issue resolution.
* Develop product\-level technical specifications, DFMEAs and test plans based on customer needs, field data and reliability requirements.
* Integrate and package mechanical, electronic and hydraulic systems, considering their interactions and dependencies.
* Communicate order configurators and colour schemes to subsystem owners to initiate bills of material.
* Clarify configurator and product\-feature queries with Customer Service and Product Management.
* Verify system\-level bills of material before release and support production\-order line issues.
* Coordinate updates and releases of service, installation and owner manuals, end\-of\-line test specifications and other technical documents.
* Track field and internal issues, maintain resolution plans, and perform engineering change\-management activities using Windchill and SAP.


****Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack** 
***(List all)*****
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electronics, with 5\-7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience launching new products while working with manufacturing teams and suppliers.
* Experience in engineering project execution, cross\-functional coordination and a stage\-gate, tollgate or milestone development process.
* Working knowledge of GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, DFMEA, FEA, tolerance analysis and statistical tools.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, with sound knowledge of engineering principles, theory and practice.


**Preferable**
* Experience integrating or designing complex electro\-mechanical systems.
* Knowledge of sheet\-metal components, stamping and bending processes, plastic injection moulds, castings and different material types.
* Working knowledge of Windchill and SAP; experience in the dispenser, home\-appliance, automotive or peripherals industry is preferred.
